title: This story is about a seven-year-old boy named Nikita who has been sent by his parents to his great-aunt's village for the whole summer. Nikita has never lived away from home without his mom and dad. He has never gone to the store or washed the dishes. He has a lot to learn, but how does he do it all? He's just a child...! His grandmother will help him with this.
